text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Having finished up their last job for the day,
{0} and Djeeta find themselves on their way back to Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その日最後の仕事を終えたジータと{0}は、
ランドソルへの帰路の途中にいた。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
We're not that far off from town, but let's take a little break.
And speaking of town, I kinda wanna do some sparring when we
get back. Sure wouldn't mind having a partner for that... *glance*
text_block_list.orig_text:
街まであと少しだけど、
ちょっと休憩だね。
今日はもう仕事もないし、
戻ったら
剣の修行に付き合って欲しいなー……
ちらっ。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
You wanna join? Woo!
I know you're getting loads stronger, so I gotta keep it up as well!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいの？　
やったぁ！
あなたもどんどん強くなるけど、
私だって負けないよ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
You remember that weird power of mine, right?
I'm calling it \"Class Change\" for now, but that's beside the point.
Basically, I wanna try all sorts of stuff so I can master it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
実はね、
この間の魔法みたいな力……
ジョブチェンジって
呼んでるんだけど、
あれを使いこなすためにも、
もっと色んなことに挑戦したいんだ。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
But that's easier said than done. I need to get stronger first.
So yeah—
text_block_list.orig_text:
それには今よりも、
もっともっと強くならなくちゃいけない。
だから……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Hey... Is it just me, or did it get a lot brighter out of nowhere?
Did the sun decide it wasn't bright enough or something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
気のせいかも知れないけど、眩しくない？
日差しが急に強くなってきたみたいで……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Actually, wait!
I know what this is! It's happened before—!
text_block_list.orig_text:
違う……！
この眩しさ、
たしか前にも──！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Let's see. These stairs are the quickest way to the faculty room...
Right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと……
職員室は、
こっちの階段を下りたほうが近いよね？
……正解？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Woo!
Now I know my way around school! Impressive, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったー！
どう？　どう？　
もう学校の中はバッチリだよ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
It's already been a week since I came to Japan,
so I wanted to make sure I memorized that much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
日本にきてもう一週間経つし、
これくらいは間違えなくなったんだから。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! I went shopping with Yui and Makoto, then they took me
to, uh, what was it? Oh, a coffee shop! ♪
And also! Karaoke! Now that was something else!
choice_data_list: I take it you had fun?
text_block_list.orig_text:
放課後は優衣や真琴と一緒に買い物にも行ったし、
日本の……
そう！　
喫茶店にも入ったんだ♪
あとはね……
カラオケ！　
日本のカラオケはすごかったなぁ……！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely! Tons of fun!
Oh... Ehehe, sorry. I got kind of carried away there,
didn't I? It really was a lot of fun, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！　
すっごく楽しかった！
あっ……
えへへ、
ごめんね。
私ばっかり喋っちゃって。
この前のことが楽しくて、
つい……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, I meant to say.
Thanks for helping me carry these handouts. It's a big help.
choice_data_list: Always willing to help a friend.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あのね。
さっきは言いそびれたんだけど、
ノート、
一緒に運んでくれて、
ありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
You really are just the same in real life
as you are in Astrum, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あなたは現実でも、
アストルムでのあなたと変わらないんだね。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Ah, man. It's nice being able to talk with you like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あー、
やっとゆっくり話せるよー！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Break time always flies by thanks to how fun it is
talking to everyone in class.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつもの休み時間は、
みんなとお話するのが楽しくて、
あっという間に終わっちゃうんだ。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
But truth be told, I've wanted more time to talk with you as well.
I mean, you're the only one who knows
what I'm like both here and in Astrum.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもね、
本当はあなたともゆっくり話せる時間が欲しくて……
だってアストルムと現実、
どっちの私も知ってるのは、
まだあなただけだから。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: You keep disappearing the second school's over, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なのにあなたは、
放課後だってすぐにどこかへ行っちゃうし……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
There's so much I still don't know about this town,
so I was hoping you'd show me around... Actually, hey!
How about we do that today? Unless you're busy, of course.
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当はね、
あなたにこの街のこと、
教えて欲しくて……
そうだ！
ねぇ、
放課後になったらどこかへ連れて行ってほしいな。
もしかして、
忙しい……？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Somewhere special? Really?
Yay! Now that sounds fun!
I'll see you after school, then!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とっておき……
本当に？
やったー！　
嬉しいなぁ……！　
放課後、
約束だからね！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Hopefully the day flies by... ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: 早く放課後にならないかな……♪

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Actually, wait. 
Which way was it to the faculty room again?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれ？　
職員室って、
どっち……！？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: After school—
text_block_list.orig_text: 放課後───

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Hey! Sorry for the wait! Let's get going!
choice_data_list: Let's take a little detour first.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お待たせー！　
じゃあ、行こっか！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: A detour? Sure! What have you got in mind?
text_block_list.orig_text:
寄り道？　
いいよ。
どこに行くの？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I know where this is.
It's the same park Yui and Makoto took me to last Sunday, I'm sure.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ここって、
公園だよね？
この前の日曜日に、
優衣たちに連れてきてもらったけど……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Hey. What's that red truck?
It wasn't here last time.
choice_data_list: Lemme go buy us some crepes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ。
あの赤い車。
この前はいなかったけど、
知ってる？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Crepes? Ohhh! They're selling them out of that!
I'll wait here, so you can decide what to get.
text_block_list.orig_text:
クレープ……
ああ、
あの車で売ってるんだ！
じゃあ味はあなたのおまかせで！　
ここで待ってるね！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Well this is new.
It's normally me dragging him around,
but now we've switched roles.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なんだか不思議だな。
いつもは私がついてきてもらってるから、
かな。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
He seems pretty friendly with the clerk, too.
Maybe he's a regular here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……店員さんと仲が良さそう。
もしかして常連さんなのかな？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... This might actually be the first time I've watched him
from behind, now that I think about it. Normally we're
standing beside each other or back to back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえば、
後姿をずっと見てるの、
初めてな気がする……
横に並んだり、
背中を預けてばっかりなんだ、
私って。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back. This is... chocolate banana flavor, I assume?
I'll take that, then.*munch*
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかえり。
えーっと、
チョコバナナで合ってる？
じゃあこっちをもらうね。
いただきまーす。
あむっ……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, pretty good. But not like, super delicious?
Not bad, either. Just... okay? Yeah, that's it. Regular old okay.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
おいしい。
ただ、
すっごくおいしいわけじゃなくて、
でもおいしくないわけじゃないっていうか……
えーっと……
普通！　
そう、
普通だね！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm trying here!
It's just... hard to describe as anything other than that.
Huh...? Don't laugh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちゃんと褒めようと思ってるんだよ？
でも普通以外に何て言えばいいか分からない味で……
えっ？　
なんで笑うかなー

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Well. That was \"just\" okay all the way to the end.
Definitely one of the most... unique crepes I've had.
text_block_list.orig_text:
全部食べたけど、やっぱり普通だった……
なんなんだろう、あのクレープ……
すごく不思議な味……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's almost time? Yay!
I won't lie, I've been dying to see this place
ever since you mentioned it. Call me excited!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そろそろ時間？　
ようやくあなたのとっておきの場所に出発だね！
どんなところなんだろ……？　
わくわく……！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow! I didn't know there was an observation deck here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁ……！　
展望台だ！

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Look, the sun's about to set!
It's so pretty...
text_block_list.orig_text:
見て、
夕日がもうすぐ沈みそう！
キレイ……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
It's not just the location itself, is it?
It's that and the scenery that make this place special to you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ここが、
この景色が、
あなたのとっておきなんだね。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
That's why we took the little detour through the park, right?
So we could make it here just in time for this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから公園に寄り道して、
クレープを食べたんだ。
ちょうどいいタイミングで、ここへ来られるように……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Thanks. I'm glad you were willing to show me this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう。
あなたのとっておきを教えてくれて。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
It's a slight bit different,
but the sunset back home was always really pretty as well.
Sure brings back memories...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……故郷で見てたのとは少し違うけど、
夕日がキレイなのは変わらないね。
懐かしいな……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
This place really is lovely.
It'd be nice if I could bring you to my hometown one day.
Then I'd show you my favorite spot there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この場所、
すごく素敵だね。
いつかあなたにも、
私の住んでた街の、
とっておきを見せてあげたいな。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
And hey.
It'd be worth showing you all the nice spots nearby, too.
How does that sound?
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかく私の故郷に行くなら、
途中で他にも色んな場所を旅したりとか！
あなたはどう？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Right? You know what else would be great? If we could
explore all around the world, same way we do in Astrum.
Together, of course!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だよね！　
アストルムみたいに、
いつか現実でも、
世界中の色んな場所を冒険したいな！
あなたと一緒に！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
So, how'd you like that little present?
Bet it was a nice dream for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうだった？　
あたしからの贈り物。
いい『夢』だったでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
You had a special little place, huh? 
Nothing wrong with that.
She seemed really happy about it, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたのとっておきの場所ねぇ……
まぁ、悪くないんじゃない？
あの子も喜んでたみたいだし。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
And hey, exploring the world sounds like fun.
Think you've got what it takes to fulfill that wish, though?
I'll wish you luck either way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人で色んな場所を冒険なんて楽しそうじゃない。
その願い、
あんたに叶えられるのかしら……？
まあ、頑張ってみなさい。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: That's enough for today, though. Catch you later. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
またね～♪

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...
Did I... Did I randomly fall asleep again?
text_block_list.orig_text:
んん……
私、
また眠っちゃってたの……？

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text: Good morning... is what I'd say if the sun wasn't ready to set.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おはよう……
っていっても、
そろそろ太陽が沈みそうだけど。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
So I had a dream just now. And the scenery in it was really pretty.
Just as pretty as the sunset right now... Actually, no.
Even prettier. It really was special.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきね、
夢の中ですごくキレイな景色を見たんだ。
この夕日と同じくらい……
ううん、
それ以上にキレイな、
とっておきの景色を。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
If the world within our dreams is full of stuff like that, 
then I sure wouldn't mind exploring it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんなのがたくさん見られるなら、
夢の中の世界を冒険するのも楽しそうだなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I shouldn't get ahead of myself, should I?
This world's huge enough as it is. Adding more to our plate's
a recipe for disaster, isn't it? Ehehe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
たはは……
私、
なに言ってるんだろ。
この世界だけでも広くて全然周りきれてないのに、
夢の中まで冒険するなら、
すっごく大変だよね……
えへへ。

text_block_list.name: Djeeta
text_block_list.text:
Well, it is. But that reality isn't enough to put me off.
There's so much to see in the world. So much to experience.
I wanna make the most of it, together with you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……それでも、
大変だとしても、
広い世界の色んな場所を、
もっとたくさんこの目で見てみたいな。
あなたと一緒に……！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Djeeta, much like in their dream,
stared off into the sunset with a brilliant smile on her face.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ジータは夢の中と同じように、
夕日の沈む先を見つめながら微笑みを浮かべていた。
